profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its website, it is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy foundation models and AI at scale on any cloud.

The site describes orchestrating model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability. It quotes Anastasis Germanidis saying Anyscale lets his team push the boundaries of generative AI by scaling workloads seamlessly, which he says removes infrastructure risk and lets the team focus on innovation rather than infrastructure bottlenecks. A second, unnamed applied AI engineer is quoted saying that after a colleague proposed using a particular model, it was running in production the next day, where before Anyscale that would have taken a week or more.

No products, MCP servers, or lawsuits involving the company are listed in the available records.
